method.name: message
method.digest: Apply a structured analyzer control envelope
method.description: Apply a structured analyzer control envelope

attribute.name: fftsize
attribute.digest: FFT analysis window size in samples
attribute.description: FFT analysis window size in samples. Must be power of two.

attribute.name: lowfreqsmoothing
attribute.digest: Amount of extra smoothing applied to low frequencies
attribute.description: Amount of extra smoothing applied to low frequencies.

attribute.name: smoothing
attribute.digest: Frequency-dependent temporal smoothing for output curves
attribute.description: Frequency-dependent temporal smoothing for output curves. Low frequencies are smoothed more strongly.

attribute.name: spectrumcalibrationdb
attribute.digest: Display calibration offset for the analyzer spectrum in dB
attribute.description: Display calibration offset for the analyzer spectrum in dB.

attribute.name: spectrumtiltdb
attribute.digest: Visual tilt of the analyzer spectrum in dB
attribute.description: Visual tilt of the analyzer spectrum in dB. Positive values lift high frequencies.
